scope: Four completed current-epoch PostgreSQL fixed-load scenes; original completed execution/comparison metadata only. No capacity or long-run acceptance is established here.
input_hash_policy: Private projection identities were checked as small metadata. Original result, summary, native and other source hashes are the hashes already recorded by completed execution/comparison receipts; no raw or binary hash was recomputed.
publication_scope: Explicit numeric/schema whitelist plus filename-and-hash provenance. Operational paths and map keys, command arguments/environments, process identities, addresses, build maps and TLS material are omitted. Originals are unchanged; this is not a byte-identical verifier input or a raw-evidence archive.
aggregation: Original equal-weight arithmetic means of independent process metrics. C16 p99 is the mean of three process p99 values, not a pooled p99; C1/C4/C8 each contain one process per role.
resource_scope: Original whole mixed-load application CPU/RSS only; never assigned to cycle/page slices. PostgreSQL service CPU/RSS and exact SQL, pool and lock wait durations are unavailable.
rss_aggregation: The Markdown RSS column and copied resource deltas use the original mean of independent-process peak RSS values. JSON also preserves each peak and its maximum. The final report adapter uses maximum-of-process-peaks, which is a different statistic.
delta_definition: absolute = candidate - reference; percent = absolute / reference * 100. before-to-after uses before as reference; after-to-direct gap uses direct as reference. Zero or missing denominators remain unavailable.
statistical_scope: Only original decisions on process means are retained. No p99/resource significance test or bootstrap is run by this projection. C1/C4/C8 remain descriptive and ineligible; C16 has three independent processes per role.
comparison_selection: The six original comparisons per scene with candidate after and baseline before or direct are retained. Managed observations are retained, but no new managed comparison decision is synthesized.
reader_limitations: Latency includes real HTTP, authentication, typed application work, C#/Rust binding, SQL and I/O; it is not isolated database execution latency.
Independent processes are the comparison units. No failed or missing-valued supplied process is dropped; incomplete metrics are N/A. Percent change from a zero baseline is N/A.
A21 nearest-rank p50/p95/p99 are withheld below their sample-count limits. Median uses the conventional mean of the two center values for an even count.
The unchanged A21 bootstrap concerns process means only, not p99. Frozen noise bands are never recalibrated or widened from these comparison results.

Whole-load CPU/RSS and generator resources are not assigned to conditional cycle/page slices. PostgreSQL service CPU/RSS, exact SQL/pool/lock wait durations and internal SQLite busy-handler retries are unavailable.
SQLite BUSY/LOCKED and explicit retry observations cover the complete application lifetime; independently queried durable measurement commits exclude seed, warmup and recovery mutations.
Equal successful throughput at one offered rate does not establish equal maximum capacity. Capacity ladders and overload/recovery results remain separate.

This checks recorded consistency and hashes, not historical authenticity or actual network/persistence correctness again. Inputs with prior hashes are compared; all consumed inputs receive new hashes.
The provided noise SHA must already be bound in the before-only frozen Plan record; a JSON creation timestamp alone cannot prove publication chronology.
retention_implication: Continue the selected candidate without a PostgreSQL-driven revert: C16 page mean has the original improvement decision; C16 whole/cycle remain inconclusive, with no before-to-after formal regression decision. Preserve adverse C1/C4/C8 descriptive observations. These combined-version measurements do not isolate any individual change, and direct-Rust regression labels describe the remaining comparator gap. Other domains, capacity and long-run acceptance remain separate.
